description: 국토교통부_공항간 운항거리 [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 이 데이터는 출발공항과 도착공항의 IATA 코드 및 공항명, 그리고 두 공항 간의 직선거리(Great Circle Distance, km) 정보를 포함합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 공항간거리, 출도착공항거리, 국내공항운항거리, 공항별항로거리, 항공오선거리계산. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-02-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
